Results.Name: HIPAA-Compliant Patient Portal
Results.Description: Deliver a fully HIPAA-compliant patient portal with secure records management, appointment booking, and provider communication.

Results.Name: Patient records data layer with PHI encryption
Results.Description: Build the data layer that stores, encrypts, syncs and audits patient health information across services.

Results.Name: Accessible appointment booking experience
Results.Description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant appointment booking flow with calendar, time-slot selection, and confirmation.

Results.Name: Patient record sync with optimistic locking
Results.Description: Ensure all patient record updates use version-based optimistic locking to prevent race conditions.

Results.Name: Keyboard-navigable appointment calendar
Results.Description: Calendar date picker must be fully operable via keyboard with visible focus indicators and ARIA labels.
